profile_text.body:
Waabi, founded in 2021 and based in Toronto, Ontario, develops AI-first autonomous transportation solutions. The company describes its approach around a Physical AI Platform that it says enables "true scale, generalizing to different form factors, geographies, and environments." According to its website, the same underlying AI model serves as a shared brain for both autonomous trucks and robotaxis.

The company positions its autonomous trucking product as transforming supply chain operations by scaling freight capabilities, improving safety, and boosting efficiency. Waabi describes its offering as "faster, safer, more scalable, and efficient" compared to existing alternatives. It highlights both highway and surface street capabilities that it says enable a direct-to-customer trucking model and entry into the robotaxi market.

Waabi has partnered with Volvo Autonomous Solutions. The company notes that such partnerships advance autonomous technology while building the ecosystem needed for commercial deployment.
